Trump falsely claims ‘nobody’s been killed’ in Iran war ‘in the last five months’

In July, three soldiers died in an enemy attack on an air base in Jordan, another died at an air base in Iraq and a Navy captain died during an emergency landing in the Arabian Sea.

November 13, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ESTToday at 10:00 a.m. EST
2 min
By Maegan Vazquez

President Donald Trump defended the U.S. war against Iran in a pair of interviews that aired Thursday evening, falsely claimed that no American troops had been killed in the past five months and said he hasn’t escalated the conflict at the request of other countries in the Middle East.
